AI Firm Anthropic Debuts on Stock Market with High Valuation

AI company Anthropic has made its debut on the stock market, closing its first day of public trading with a valuation of $1.3 trillion. The company's initial public offering (IPO) is described as the largest ever. Reports indicate Anthropic's spending plan amounts to $900 billion, raising concerns about junk bonds despite its significant valuation. The company's seven co-founders, former colleagues from OpenAI, collectively hold paper wealth exceeding $180 billion. Shares closed up 17% on their first day of trading.
